display_fields.shelfmark: Quadripartitus: not a manuscript, but the Latin translation of the laws (c. 1110), which survives in several MSS

notes.text: Liebermann’s Q is the Quadripartitus, the early twelfth-century Latin translation of the Old English laws. It is listed with the law codes, where its own MSS are given. In Excom XII alone, Liebermann’s Q is a manuscript, Cotton Vespasian D.xv (the next entry).
